claims: Transfuse red blood cells for symptomatic anemia (hemoglobin 7.6-7.7 g/dL).
Continue broad-spectrum antibiotics (piperacillin-tazobactam and vancomycin) for suspected infection with leukocytosis.
Monitor glucose closely and adjust insulin/TPN to maintain glucose in target range (finger sticks 178-185 mg/dL).
Replete potassium given hypokalemia (3.2 mEq/L) and continue monitoring electrolytes.
Continue telemetry and ST-segment monitoring for tachycardia (HR 106-115 bpm) and elevated NT-proBNP (1405 pg/mL).
Continue supplemental oxygen to maintain SpO2 above 92% (currently 2 L/min, SpO2 92-96%).
Assess and manage moderate to severe pain with multimodal analgesia.
Continue enteral/parenteral nutrition support with TPN and monitor tolerance and metabolic parameters.
Monitor coagulation parameters (INR 1.7, PT 18.3 sec, PTT 28.4 sec) and platelet count (468-563 K/uL).
Perform daily assessment of skin integrity and fall risk given bed rest and Braden score indicating risk.
